recognitionRules: Use the dark ground and slightly lighter panels as an instrument surface.
Reserve mint for supported comparison emphasis and amber for gaps.
Align chart scales and comparison rows to the same numerical frame.
Keep the scope band and method adjacent to the interpretation.

writingLinks.name: Research register
writingLinks.reason: Bounded snapshot comparison that keeps missing outcomes visible.

quote: Compare what is present. Keep what is missing in view.
rightsSummary: Original fictional identity and vector logos; portable font binaries retain their licenses. Source family dependencies and substitutions are documented.
logoDirection: Use STUDIO / EVIDENCE as a compact Avenir wordmark separated by a thin slash. A small pair of aligned scale ticks may accompany it; no dashboard gauge icon.
invariants: Use the dark ground and slightly lighter panels as an instrument surface.
Reserve mint for supported comparison emphasis and amber for gaps.
Align chart scales and comparison rows to the same numerical frame.
adaptations: Light print editions translate dark panels into rule-separated areas.
Retain gap labels even when color is removed.
Keep the full name with any new symbol until the audience can recognize it independently.
decisionStatus: Template-derived editorial identity for the requested library. Creative rules are proposed production directions; no real organization or official endorsement is asserted.
